sloka: स नुन्नैव तीक्षेन प्रतोदेन हय उत्तमः ।राजा प्रदोचितः अभीक्ष्णम् कैकेयीम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥२-१४-२३॥
transliteration: sa nunnaiva tīkṣena pratodena haya uttamaḥ ।rājā pradocitaḥ abhīkṣṇam kaikeyīm idam abravīt ॥2-14-23॥

translations.english: The king who was very much incited by her words, like a horse of the best breed whipped by the lash, replied to Kaikeyi:
